entry_points.summary: Canonical export result dataclass (dest, files, fidelity, warnings); owned by runtime, re-exported from z_harness_cli/adapters/base.py
Collect skills and agents from skills/ and agents/ into a kind-keyed dict; keeps back-compat commands: [] key so deferred export-only drivers (copilot/kiro/windsurf/pi) do not KeyError
Public alias for expand_includes; base_dir accepted but unused (always resolves relative to repo_root)
Inline <!-- include: path --> markers recursively; skips fenced code blocks; raises on missing fragment or cycle
Compute conventional output path for cursor or codex targets; agy absent (owns its own dual layout)
Require ## Supported, ## Unsupported, ## Notes sections in CAPABILITIES.md
Frozenset of always-on agent IDs (implementer, reviewer, auditor, mr-reviewer, remote-runner); single source of truth imported by agy/windsurf/kiro drivers
Pure helper: given strategy (pointer|curated|full) + enumerated sources, return filtered subset to emit
Read export.strategy from scripts/config.py get (subprocess); falls back to driver-supplied default when config absent
Verify fragment include expansion; ported from scripts/export-common.py cmd_self_test

Emit AGENT .mdc rules to .cursor/rules/ and native SKILL.md files to .cursor/skills/<id>/SKILL.md; write exactly one generated always-apply .cursor/rules/z-harness-skills.mdc index; fidelity=flattened
Replace Agent/Skill/tool-schema call sites with Cursor limitation comment line-by-line
Render one AGENT entry as a Cursor .mdc rule with YAML frontmatter (description, alwaysApply); not used for skills (those are written verbatim)
Emit Codex prompt files and consolidated AGENTS.md; validate prompts; fidelity=flattened
Replace unsupported call sites with Codex limitation comment
Render command or skill as Codex prompt with # /<id> header
Consolidate all agents into a single AGENTS.md
Emit all agy surfaces: workflows, rules, skills, flat prompts, manifest, CAPABILITIES.md, README.md; fidelity=high
Render command as Antigravity workflow .md (description frontmatter, 250-char limit, --- escaping)
Render agent as Antigravity rule .md with always_on or model_decision trigger
Render skill as native Antigravity SKILL.md under .agent/skills/<id>/SKILL.md
Generate agy-plugin.yaml export manifest (z-harness convention only; not read by agy natively)
Emit pi agent files, prompts, vendored subagent extension, AGENTS.md index; export-only target; fidelity=high
Map comma-separated frontmatter tools string to pi tool names; returns (pi_tools, dropped)
Return pi-flavored subagent-tool hint for Agent/Skill/tool call sites, or None to keep line
Inject PROMPT_DEFENSE_BLOCK after <!-- PROMPT_DEFENSE_MARKER -->; falls back to after heading; idempotent
Re-export of runtime ExportResult; CLI-layer code imports from here, never from runtime directly
Protocol: delegate to runtime export(), run persona loop from personas/builtin/, merge results; raise RuntimeError on non-empty warnings
Two-stage: cursor runtime export then persona loop from personas/builtin/; RuntimeError on validation errors; fidelity=flattened
Two-stage: codex runtime export then persona loop from personas/builtin/; RuntimeError on validation errors; fidelity=flattened
Two-stage: agy runtime export then persona loop from personas/builtin/; RuntimeError on validation errors; fidelity=high
User-facing entry point: python3 -m z_harness_cli export --host <host> --out <dest> for cursor/codex/agy; pi and export-only drivers via direct import; no output is committed

invariants: Source of truth is skills/<id>/SKILL.md, agents/, and personas/builtin/ — skills/ is the only hand-authored committed source tier; commands/ markdown directory has been deleted; per-host export artifacts are generated on demand and never committed
ExportResult is owned by runtime/drivers/_export_utils.py; z_harness_cli code imports it only via z_harness_cli/adapters/base.py (one-way layering)
All four core runtime export() functions share signature: export(repo_root, export_root, *, options=None) -> ExportResult
Non-empty ExportResult.warnings from the runtime export() are raised as RuntimeError by every adapter's export_payload() (legacy hard-gate preserved)
Unsupported constructs (Agent, Skill, AskUserQuestion, TaskCreate, SubagentCreate) are replaced line-by-line with target-specific HTML comments, never silently dropped
Each adapter validates all emitted files before reporting success; CAPABILITIES.md must contain ## Supported, ## Unsupported, ## Notes sections

Cursor and Codex append -skill suffix if a skill ID collides with an agent ID in export output; agy flat prompts use skill- prefix; legacy command/skill collision logic is no longer relevant (commands/ deleted)
output_path_for handles only cursor and codex; agy is intentionally absent (owns its dual layout)
pi is export-only: no adapter, no HostDriver, no --host pi CLI flag; export runs via direct import of runtime.drivers.pi.export
pi has no persona export; persona export (from personas/builtin/) runs only for cursor, codex, and agy

Per-host export artifacts are generated on demand and never committed; exports/ tree was deleted and .gitignored; to generate: python3 -m z_harness_cli export --host <host> --out <any-dest>; --in-place writes into cwd for live workspace install
/z-export performs no direct file I/O; all writes are delegated to runtime export() and persona_export.py modules
_ALWAYS_ON_AGENTS is defined once in _export_utils.py and imported by every driver that needs it (agy, windsurf, kiro); never redefined per-driver
audit-tarball.sh is the safety gate for packaged artifacts, independent of the export drivers
gotchas: skills/<id>/SKILL.md is the ONLY hand-authored committed source tier — commands/ markdown directory is deleted; enumerate_sources walks skills/*/SKILL.md and keeps a back-compat commands: [] key; cursor export writes verbatim .cursor/skills/<id>/SKILL.md (no transliteration)
Legacy scripts/export-{common,cursor,codex,agy}.py have been deleted; runtime/drivers/<target>/export.py is the only current path
output_path_for intentionally omits agy — the agy exporter owns a dual layout (.agent/ + prompts/) that cannot be expressed as a single path

--in-place flag on the CLI export command writes into cwd for live workspace install; no exports/ committed mirror exists (it was deleted and .gitignored); use --out <any-dest> to generate artifacts to any directory
inline_includes accepts base_dir for API symmetry but never uses it; resolution is always relative to repo_root (preserved quirk from legacy export-common.py)
Codex consolidates all agents into AGENTS.md — no per-agent prompt files are emitted

agy _ALWAYS_ON_AGENTS is defined in _export_utils.py and imported by antigravity/export.py (not redefined there); single source of truth covers implementer, reviewer, auditor, mr-reviewer, remote-runner
agy-plugin.yaml is a z-harness convention manifest; Antigravity does not read it natively
Antigravity workflow bodies have an ~12,000 character limit; several z-harness commands exceed it
pi asset files (CAPABILITIES.md, AGENTS.preamble.md, explore.md, extensions/) live in scripts/pi_assets/; resolved __file__-relative for standalone import
pi model tier mapping: haiku -> deepseek-v4-flash, sonnet/opus -> deepseek-v4-pro
pi injects PROMPT_DEFENSE_BLOCK after <!-- PROMPT_DEFENSE_MARKER -->; falls back to after the heading line if no sentinel found

Cursor personas are alwaysApply: true .mdc rules under .cursor/personas/ (no native Cursor persona mechanism); Cursor SKILLS are written verbatim as .cursor/skills/<id>/SKILL.md (native Cursor 2.4+ mechanism, not .mdc transliteration)
z_harness_cli/adapters/base.py re-exports ExportResult as __all__ = ['ExportResult'] so tests that import from base get the runtime type
select_sources and resolve_strategy are used by export-only drivers (windsurf, kiro, cline, copilot) but not by the core four (cursor, codex, agy, pi) which enumerate all sources unconditionally
